name: HiPhO
description: HiPhO is the first benchmark dedicated to high school physics Olympiads with human-aligned evaluation. It compiles recent Olympiad exams covering text and diagram-based problems, uses official marking schemes for fine-grained grading, and enables direct comparison between (M)LLMs and human contestants.
reputation: A new, specialized benchmark for Olympiad-level physics that is early in adoption and primarily of interest to multimodal reasoning and education researchers.
notes: Includes 13 latest Olympiad exams from 2024-2025; provides official marking schemes and medal-based human comparison; covers mixed modalities from text to diagrams.
